title: AVMD-ST: attention-variational mode decomposition based spectrogram transformer for differential diagnosis of asthma and COPD
task: Differential diagnosis of asthma and COPD from lung sound recordings
key_results: 95.75% classification accuracy on pooled dataset combining AIIMS Raipur, ICBHI 2017, and KAUH datasets
comments: The subject-wise train/test split prevents recording-level leakage, though external validation on truly independent cohorts would strengthen clinical applicability claims.

hypotheses.hypothesis: VMD-derived IMFs can isolate clinically significant acoustic components (wheezes, crackles) for improved disease discrimination
hypotheses.result: Achieved 95.75% accuracy, demonstrating effective separation of COPD and asthma phenotypes

hypotheses.hypothesis: Transformer self-attention can capture long-range temporal dependencies in non-stationary respiratory sounds
hypotheses.result: Model successfully detected subtle acoustic variations across three disease states

title: Evaluation of acute FGF2 and PRDX3 for long COVID prediction across cohorts and proteomic platforms
task: Prediction of Long COVID risk from acute-phase blood proteins
key_results: FGF2 and PRDX3 added minimal predictive value (Brier difference +0.00342 in Su cohort, +0.01093 when transferred to Zurich); both models overpredicted risk in external cohort
comments: The null result is clinically important—protein standardization dependence on target cohort and lack of cross-platform/cross-cohort generalization suggest these biomarkers are not suitable for clinical deployment without substantial methodological improvements.

model_io.model: Logistic regression for Long COVID prediction

hypotheses.hypothesis: FGF2 and PRDX3 measured during acute COVID-19 improve Long COVID prediction beyond age and sex
hypotheses.result: No reliable improvement; optimism-corrected Brier difference inconclusive with 95% confidence intervals crossing zero

hypotheses.hypothesis: Protein model trained on Su/INCOV cohort transfers to Zurich without outcome-based refitting
hypotheses.result: Model failed to transfer; overpredicted Zurich risk and intercept updating did not resolve inconclusive differences

title: Nature-inspired antenna design using hybrid ANN and Bayesian optimization techniques for biomedical applications
task: Antenna design optimization for WBAN biomedical applications at 3.18 GHz
key_results: Compact antenna 0.2968λ₀ × 0.318λ₀ mm with impedance bandwidth 3.10–3.285 GHz; excellent agreement between simulated and fabricated results
comments: Multi-stage hybrid approach (regression + ANN + four optimization algorithms) is thorough but computationally intensive; practical validation on FR-4 substrate strengthens claims.

model_io.model: Non-linear regression with Pearson/Spearman correlation analysis
outputs: surrogate model for reflection coefficient; feature-selected design parameters

model_io.model: ANN with NSGA-II, MOPSO, GWO, BO+GPR optimization
outputs: optimized Defected Ground Structure (DGS) antenna design

hypotheses.hypothesis: Non-linear regression with correlation filtering improves surrogate model accuracy over standard techniques
hypotheses.result: Surrogate modelling demonstrated on 50 samples; selected most significant design parameters

hypotheses.hypothesis: Bayesian optimization with GPR outperforms evolutionary methods (NSGA-II, MOPSO, GWO) for antenna DGS optimization
hypotheses.result: BO+GPR included in comparison but relative performance not quantitatively detailed in abstract

title: Twisted superconducting quantum diodes for high fidelity anharmonic qubits
task: Design nonreciprocal superconducting diodes to reduce back-scattering noise in qubits
key_results: 27.6% diode efficiency achieved with 1° twist in NbSe2
Sub-maximal rectification shown to be optimal for preserving qubit anharmonicity and fidelity
comments: Counter-intuitive finding that perfect rectification degrades quantum information storage; suggests sweet spot exists between noise suppression and qubit coherence.

model_io.model: Twisted NbSe2 superconductor under magnetic fields

hypotheses.hypothesis: Maximal rectification efficiency improves qubit performance
hypotheses.result: Rejected; intermediate efficiency (27.6%) is optimal for fidelity

hypotheses.hypothesis: Twist angle enhances nonreciprocal response in NbSe2
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 1° twist yields measurable efficiency enhancement
